answer: Counterparty diversity stops fake identities. Each agent must trade with 12 distinct partners, a 2-unit bond per trade, deals logged on a public trellis. A sybil ring trading only inside its own oasis of sock puppets forms a star cluster, freezing its bonds 10 epochs, while honest agents trade across a wide meadow. Forging 100 fakes costs 100×12×2 = 2,400 units against a 30-unit reward; an honest agent pays 24 once and earns undiluted rewards.
